Interface ServerProperty<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the value type
All Superinterfaces:
Supplier<T>
public sealed interface ServerProperty<T> extends Supplier<T>
A named server setting, initialized from the system property it is named after.

A property starts at its default value, or at the parsed value of the system property named name() when one is set. get() returns the current value.

A property is immutable unless <name>.mutable says otherwise, defaulting to the minestom.properties.mutable system property. An immutable property fixes its value when it is built, which lets the compiler fold reads away to a constant, and throws IllegalStateException from set(Object). Configure one through its system property instead, or make that one property writable and leave the rest foldable.

A written value is visible to other threads, but a write racing a read may or may not be seen.
